long_description:
Leap into this New Year in your yoga practice. 

The beginning of the New Year is traditionally a time for renewal. Join us in your Yoga practice on New Year's Day. Lay the foundation of the New Year by setting new intentions on your yoga mat with an energizing Vinyasa & Restorative practice, led by Tamara. This practice will leave you feeling grounded+spacious and ready to take on 2027!

This is an all levels, a day of intention, come as you are yoga practice.

Available to Soluna Members, Package of classes, or $25 drop-in. 

Registration in advance is required as space is limited. 

Click on the event link to sign up. 

This will be the only yoga class offered on New Year's Day at Soluna Yoga+Spa. 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Jacksonville, Workshops in Jacksonville.
